en: Welcome to the Lost Integration! (otherwise known as World 2!)
zh: 欢迎来到遗失积分！（也就是世界 2！）

en: This is an entirely different version of the game. Most mechanics are overhauled or entirely replaced. This world's mechanics are
zh: 这是一个完全不同的游戏版本。大多数机制都经过彻底改造或完全替换。这个世界的机制

en: inspired by the plans for "Algebraic Progression Classic", the first iteration of the game made in 2020, and also scrapped ideas
zh: 受到“Algebraic Progression Classic”（游戏于 2020 年制作的第一版）方案的启发，也受到一些被废弃创意的启发，

en: for mechanics that never made it into the current version of the game.
zh: 这些创意是为那些从未进入当前版本游戏的机制而提出的。

en: Each section afterward covers every important mechanic in the game that may require explaining. There are a few things that you
zh: 之后的每一节都会涵盖游戏中可能需要解释的所有重要机制。有几件事你

en: should know before you continue your journey:
zh: 在继续旅程之前应该先了解：

en: Some aspects of this world may have been rushed during development. If you find any bugs, report them to the developer!
zh: 这个世界的某些方面在开发过程中可能比较仓促。如果你发现任何漏洞，请向开发者报告！

en: There are several visual changes of this world compared to the first. Can you find them all?
zh: 与第一个世界相比，这个世界有一些视觉上的变化。你能把它们都找出来吗？

en: Once unlocked, most autobuyers can be found in a single tab instead of being scattered across all of the tabs.
zh: 解锁后，大多数自动购买器都可以在一个标签页中找到，而不是分散在各个标签页中。
